image_description: A composite image showing two views (top and bottom) of a vintage Smith-Corona Clipper Viceroy Deluxe typewriter. The device features a teal/blue metal casing with cream-colored round keys. The focus is on the keyboard layout, specifically the elongated key at the bottom center.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated rectangular key spanning the full width of the bottom keyboard row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is present but does not span the 'full width' of the row; it is flanked by modifier keys (shift/lock) on both sides. It is significantly longer than letter keys but not full-width.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visually, the space bar is approximately 6-7 times the width of a single round key, not ten times. The 'ten times' metric is an exaggeration for this specific vintage layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is flat or slightly concave.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar appears to have a slight concave curvature consistent with the round key aesthetic, or is flat with rounded edges. It matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Underside connects to a long stabilizer bar mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside and internal mechanical stabilizer bars are completely occluded by the top-down viewing angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label is typically blank with no printed character.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is clearly blank, lacking any printed characters, unlike the letter keys.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Positioned centrally between modifier keys on the bottom row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is centrally located in the bottom row, bordered by larger modifier keys on the left and right.
The keys exhibit a smooth, non-glossy finish consistent with vintage plastic or bakelite.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Typically white, black, or gray to match keyboard color scheme.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is cream/off-white, matching the other keys and contrasting with the teal body, fitting the color scheme.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Part of a standard computer or typewriter keyboard.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly part of a vintage typewriter keyboard.

artifact_observations.location: Top image, right side of the typewriter body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The right edge of the typewriter casing in the top image appears to warp and melt into the background table surface, lacking a distinct, sharp boundary compared to the bottom image.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom image, teal casing near the carriage return lever
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight smudging or inconsistent texture resolution on the metal casing, appearing softer than the crisp edges of the keys.
The rows of keys show slight waviness rather than perfect parallel alignment, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation.
